source_documents.title: PS3 Ignore All DTC in ADPU
source_documents.evidence: Exact 12 ADPU DTCs, fault state Intermittent, vehicle type 359, MY2024–2026, structural weeks 202402–202616; service advises no replacement or fault tracing for listed codes

source_documents.title: Climate System Cooling Performance
source_documents.evidence: HPA P26FD68, intermittent/permanent, PS3 MY2025, check QB1052 tag and complete campaign as applicable before VIDA fault tracing

source_documents.title: PS Exterior Sound DTC
source_documents.evidence: AUD B1A0213 permanent; PS3 MY2026+ from structure week 202546; front-right AVAS speaker not installed from factory; no fault tracing/replacement for that isolated DTC

records.manufacturer_document_context_en: Intermittent poor A/C cooling performance with HPA P26FD68
records.trigger_conditions: Activation thresholds not published; see TJ context

diagnostic_steps.action_en: Confirm HPA P26FD68 and intermittent poor A/C performance; verify the model year against the journal.
diagnostic_steps.action_ar: تحقق من P26FD68 في HPA ومن ضعف التبريد المتقطع ومطابقة سنة الموديل.

diagnostic_steps.action_en: Check whether the vehicle is tagged for Quality Bulletin QB1052 and complete QB1052 when applicable before unrelated fault tracing.
diagnostic_steps.action_ar: افحص ارتباط السيارة بالحملة QB1052 ونفذها إن كانت مطلوبة قبل بدء تتبع الأعطال.

diagnostic_steps.action_en: If not tagged for QB1052, or another A/C complaint remains, follow VIDA fault tracing specific to the VIN.
diagnostic_steps.action_ar: إن لم تنطبق الحملة، أو استمر عرض آخر بالمكيف، استخدم فحوص VIDA الخاصة بالـVIN.

records.manufacturer_document_context_en: Permanent DTC only, caused by factory specification change removing front-right AVAS speaker; no customer symptom/DIM message caused by this code

applicability.model_years: 2026+ per TJ; actual later model-year fitment requires VIN confirmation
applicability.variant: Front-right AVAS speaker removed at factory from 2025w46

records.trigger_conditions: DTC stored in production following documented speaker-spec change
symptoms: Code visible in VIDA only; bulletin says no customer-facing symptoms or DIM warning caused by the listed code

diagnostic_steps.action_en: Verify Polestar 3 AUD B1A0213 and structure week 2025w46 or later.
diagnostic_steps.action_ar: تحقق من AUD-B1A0213 في Polestar 3 وأسبوع الإنتاج 2025w46 أو بعده.

diagnostic_steps.action_en: Under TJ 37594.1.0, do not fault-trace or replace hardware for this code: the front-right AVAS speaker is no longer factory-installed.
diagnostic_steps.action_ar: وفق TJ 37594.1.0 لا تفحص أو تبدّل عتاداً لهذا الرمز؛ السماعة اليمنى الأمامية لم تعد جزءاً من تجهيز المصنع.

diagnostic_steps.action_en: Do not attribute independent actual AVAS acoustic failures to this ghost code; assess separately if customer has a real complaint.
diagnostic_steps.action_ar: إذا وُجد خلل حقيقي في صوت التنبيه الخارجي فلا تنسبه تلقائياً لهذا الكود، بل افحصه بشكل مستقل.
